entries.title: A merge card says who does each step after it
entries.body: Each step a merge card lists for after the merge now says who does it. A change in the app itself, such as removing an Automation rule, goes straight to your first mate when the merge goes through, instead of starting a crewmate that cannot reach it.

picture.alt: A merge card whose after-merge step reads that your first mate does it in the app and no crewmate starts
